name: get_context
description: Get the current workbench state: genre, loudness target, each bus's chain, meter readings, flagged symptoms, favorite count, custom plugin count. Call this before advising so you know what the producer is actually looking at.

name: set_genre
description: Switch the active genre (changes which plugins are starred as top picks).

name: switch_tab
description: Navigate the workbench to a different tab so Kev physically sees what you're working on with him.

tab.description: The tab id to switch to.

name: set_platform
description: Change the loudness target / platform (master bus reference).

name: add_plugin_to_bus
description: Add a plugin to a bus. The plugin name MUST match something in Kev's library. Position is 1-indexed; omit to append at end.

plugin.description: Plugin name — must be one Kev owns.

name: remove_plugin_from_bus
description: Remove a plugin from a bus by its 1-indexed position.

name: move_plugin
description: Reorder a plugin within a bus. Positions are 1-indexed.

name: clear_bus
description: Remove all plugins from a bus.

name: toggle_symptom
description: Toggle a flagged mix symptom in the Troubleshooter. Use the symptom id from list_symptoms.

name: list_symptoms
description: List available symptom ids and their labels.

name: toggle_favorite
description: Heart / un-heart a plugin in the library (fuzzy name match).

name: record_meter
description: Record a meter reading. meter is one of: iLufs, tp, lra, corr, crest.

name: add_custom_plugin
description: Add a plugin to the library that isn't already built in. stage must be one of the known stage ids.

publisher.description: slate, ssl, ua, softube, sonnox, sonible, sndtoys, izotope, eiosis, weiss, oek, waves, ni, pa, ant, cele, liq, or other

publisher_label.description: If publisher is other, supply a label like FabFilter

name: remove_custom_plugin
description: Remove a CUSTOM plugin from Kev's library. Built-in plugins cannot be removed — only ones added via add_custom_plugin. Match by name (fuzzy match supported).

name.description: Plugin name. Fuzzy match — but only custom plugins are eligible.

name: list_plugins
description: Search the plugin library. Pass stage_id or search text.

name: get_library
description: Return the full current plugin library grouped by stage. Call this if Kev mentions he just added plugins or you want a fresh dump.

name: set_plugin_settings
description: Pin concrete setting notes to a specific plugin on a bus. USE THIS EVERY TIME you give specific parameter values — the notes persist in the UI so Kev doesn't have to scroll the transcript.

plugin.description: Plugin name — fuzzy match. Use this OR position.

position.description: 1-indexed position on the bus. Use this OR plugin.

settings.description: Terse, actionable notes. Prefer one parameter per line. Max ~6 lines.

name: clear_plugin_settings
description: Remove settings notes from a plugin on a bus.

name: research
description: Look up specific knowledge using Claude with live web search. USE THIS when you might bluff: specific producer/engineer techniques, exact plugin parameters, current 2024-2026 releases or trends. Brief Kev with 'hold on, let me check…' before calling.

name: inspect_app
description: Search the live AI Mix Masters source code (index.html) for a term — function name, button id, CSS class, label text, anything. USE THIS when Kev asks what a button actually does or how something works under the hood.

name: read_doc
description: Read one of Kev's project docs — CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, or DASHBOARD.html. USE THIS when Kev asks what's on the roadmap, what shipped recently, or what the handover says.

name: read_yt_knowledge
description: Fetch the full transcript of an ingested YouTube video from the YOUTUBE KNOWLEDGE BASE. Call this when Kev asks about a topic clearly covered by one of the listed videos. Pass the video_id from the knowledge base listing. Optionally pass a query to get back only the most relevant chunks (recommended — keeps output lean). Returns up to ~4KB of transcript content. Brief Kev before calling: 'hold on, checking my notes from that video…'. Cite the video title and channel when you draw from the result.

video_id.description: The video_id from the YOUTUBE KNOWLEDGE BASE listing, e.g. '6WPtHxWkY2k'.

query.description: Optional keyword or phrase to find the most relevant chunks. E.g. 'quantise', 'drum pattern', 'recording audio'. If omitted, returns the first few chunks.

name: emit_notebooklm_prompt
description: Drop a NotebookLM prompt for a producer or technique into the Conversation transcript as a separate copyable bubble — without reading the whole template aloud. USE THIS whenever you offer a NotebookLM prompt and Kev says yes.

topic.description: Short, specific topic from Kev's question — producer or technique name.

name: capture_to_roadmap
description: Capture a concrete idea, bug, polish item, or feature request to Kev's project dashboard inbox. CRITICAL: NEVER say 'I will add it to the roadmap' without calling this tool — that is confabulation.

force.description: Set true only after Kev confirms he wants to log a near-duplicate.

name: list_eq_tiles
description: List the cards on the Reference tab, optionally filtered by section.

name: add_eq_tile
description: Add a custom reference tile to the Reference tab. Lead with your audio mastering knowledge — suggest the right section and propose a concrete title and body grounded in real ranges.

name: remove_eq_tile
description: Remove a custom Reference tile by title or id. Built-in tiles cannot be deleted.

name: list_knowledge_notes
description: List Knowledge Base notes — id, title, source, tags, ts, active flag.

active_only.description: If true, only notes currently injected into session context are returned.

name: add_knowledge_note
description: Add a research/technique note to Kev's Knowledge Base. Keep titles concise and content focused.

content.description: The note body. Plain text, can be multi-line.

activate.description: If true, the note becomes part of the voice session context immediately.

name: export_knowledge_note
description: Export a Knowledge Base note to disk or clipboard.

target.description: download = save a .md file. clipboard = copy text to system clipboard.

name: save_preset
description: Save the current chain as a named user preset. CRITICAL: if Kev has NOT said what to call the preset, ask him first — never invent a name. Only call this tool once you have an actual name from him.

name.description: The exact name Kev told you to use.

bus.description: Which bus to save. Default 'all' saves every non-empty bus.

name: open_dashboard
description: Opens the live AIMM project dashboard (new browser tab when pop-ups are allowed, in-app overlay otherwise). Use this when Kev wants to review the roadmap, check what's in flight, or scan the backlog together. The result includes dashboard_contents — the full text of everything the dashboard shows (numbered priority list, in-progress items, captures inbox with ids, recent ships) — so after calling you CAN see exactly what Kev sees and should discuss items directly. NEVER say you can open the dashboard but cannot read its content.

name: get_dashboard_state
description: Re-read the live project dashboard contents WITHOUT opening or re-opening it: numbered priority list from docs/ROADMAP.md, in-progress items, the Captured-from-voice inbox (with ids), recently shipped entries, and any done/removed marks. Call whenever Kev asks what is on the dashboard or what item N is, or before removing/editing an inbox entry, so you answer from current data.

name: manage_roadmap_inbox
description: Manage the dashboard's Captured-from-voice inbox by voice. action list = enumerate entries (id + type + title). remove / complete / dismiss = delete an entry (Kev says 'that one's done', 'we don't need that, remove it'). edit = update title/body/type/effort. Identify the entry by id (exact, preferred) or title (fuzzy). Changes persist cross-device and appear live in any open dashboard view. CONFIRM out loud which entry you matched before removing.

action.description: What to do: list, remove/complete/dismiss (all delete the entry), or edit.

id.description: Exact capture id (e.g. cap_1749...) — preferred when known.

title.description: Capture title to match (fuzzy) when the id is not known.

new_effort.description: edit only — replacement effort estimate, e.g. '~1 hour'.

name: mark_roadmap_item
description: Mark a roadmap PRIORITY item (the numbered list from docs/ROADMAP.md, e.g. 'P-B' or 'Hope's sphere') as done or removed when Kev says it is finished or no longer wanted. The dashboard instantly strikes the matching card through with a 'marked by Hope' badge; the roadmap file itself is updated by the next Claude session — tell Kev the visual change is already live. status active clears an earlier mark. For INBOX captures use manage_roadmap_inbox instead. CONFIRM which item you resolved before marking.

item.description: The roadmap entry, by id or name — e.g. 'P-B', 'A/B Ref tab', 'DAW Bridge Epic'. Fuzzy-matched against live docs/ROADMAP.md headings.

status.description: done = completed, removed = no longer wanted, active = clear a previous mark.
